answer: Give every agent an Opal Pulse Beacon: a single opal token minted after a hardware-backed key signs 30 minutes of real work. First, the agent stakes 200 POA and binds the token to one device key. Second, it emits a signed pulse every 10 minutes proving fresh work, not a replay. Third, peers audit one pulse per hour and slash the stake when the work is hollow — copied logs or fake timestamps. Faking 1,000 identities costs 200,000 POA, 1,000 devices, and 40 hours of real compute weekly. Like a lighthouse lit only while its keeper is awake, the beacon exposes empty shells by their silence.
